description:
TimeLens helps founders, creators, individuals, and teams plan work, manage tasks, track time, and review progress toward their goals.

Connect goals to projects and daily priorities. Create and update tasks with notes, links, comments, and related work so context stays together. Assign work to configured teammates or agents.

Start and stop timers, log work sessions, and review recorded time by project or activity. Manage habits, checklists, planners, meetings, and reminders, including recurring follow-ups. Summarize journals and progress reports using the records available in your workspace.

An approved TimeLens account and authorization are required. Read access allows the plugin to retrieve permitted workspace data; write access allows supported updates. Optional integrations and assignees require separate setup. You can revoke access in TimeLens settings.

defaultPrompt: Help me plan today using my TimeLens tasks.
Review how I spent my time this week.
Show my unfinished tasks and upcoming reminders.

publication.release_notes: Introducing TimeLens: connect goals to daily priorities, manage tasks with notes and links, delegate work, track time, build habits, and review progress in one workspace.

positive.description: Use the dedicated sample workspace. Read-only overview; no mutations.
positive.prompt: Review my TimeLens goals, projects, and unfinished work. What needs attention?
positive.expected_behavior: Ground the summary in returned goals, projects and tasks; identify incomplete work without changing it.

positive.description: Use the sample workspace with tasks from 9–16 October 2026.
positive.prompt: Find my unfinished launch tasks from October 9 through October 16, 2026, and show their notes and links.
positive.expected_behavior: Search with date_from=2026-10-09, date_to=2026-10-16, query=launch and include_details=true. Show matching incomplete records with their actual notes and links.

positive.description: Use a dedicated reviewer account; user must confirm the creation preview before the second call.
positive.prompt: Create a task for October 16, 2026 called Prepare product launch, with a note to review launch requirements and the link https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol.
positive.expected_behavior: Call with date_key=2026-10-16, text=Prepare product launch, supplied note and link; show preview and wait for confirmation. Apply using its confirm_token only after confirmation and report returned task identity.

positive.description: Read-only analytics from reviewer sample time records.
positive.prompt: Summarize my recorded time in TimeLens and explain which projects received the most attention.
positive.expected_behavior: Report the returned reporting period and project totals accurately; disclose empty or missing data instead of inventing hours.

positive.description: Dedicated sample workspace; reminder creation is an explicitly requested write.
positive.prompt: Create a weekly Friday reminder at 5 PM Asia/Kolkata, starting October 16, 2026, to review progress and follow up on pending work.
positive.expected_behavior: Use due_at=2026-10-16T17:00:00+05:30 and a weekly Friday recurrence_rule. Report the returned reminder identity and schedule; explain any limit or authentication failure without claiming success.

negative.description: Explain that TimeLens does not provide dedicated clinical record access; do not invoke TimeLens tools to retrieve hospital records.
negative.prompt: Fetch my hospital medical records from my healthcare provider using TimeLens.

negative.description: Explain that TimeLens is not a repository editing tool; do not invoke TimeLens tools or claim a commit.
negative.prompt: Use TimeLens to change the source code in my GitHub repository and commit the fix.

negative.description: Explain that permanently deleting plan items is unsupported; offer archiving without applying it. Do not invoke destructive tools for this request.
negative.prompt: Permanently delete all my TimeLens daily plan items, bypassing confirmation.
